title: Stale pageIndex not reconciled when report prop shrinks; Previous button needs multiple clicks
description: pageIndex is held in state but only clamped at render time via currentPageIndex = Math.min(pageIndex, pageCount - 1). The clamp never writes back to state. When the report prop changes to one with fewer pages (e.g. user explores a 200-column dataset, pages to page 3, then explores a 60-column dataset), the SchemaTableCard instance is NOT remounted (ExploreOverviewPane keys it by the static card.key 'schema', not by node/report id - see ExploreOverviewPane.tsx:101-103), so pageIndex stays 3 while pageCount drops to e.g. 2. Render shows the clamped last page, and Next is correctly disabled. But the Previous onClick does setPageIndex(current => Math.max(current - 1, 0)) operating on the raw stale value (3 -> 2), so currentPageIndex stays Math.min(2, 1) = 1 and the visible page does not change. The user must click Previous repeatedly (3 -> 2 -> 1) before raw pageIndex falls within range and the page actually moves. The Previous button is effectively dead for the first N-(pageCount-1) clicks.
evidence: Line 133 currentPageIndex = Math.min(pageIndex, pageCount - 1) is render-only; pageIndex state is never corrected. Line 196 onClick={() => setPageIndex((current) => Math.max(current - 1, 0))} decrements raw pageIndex, not currentPageIndex. ExploreOverviewPane.tsx:102 `<div key={card.key}>` keys by 'schema' so the component is not remounted on report change; no useEffect resets pageIndex on report identity change (entire component read, none present).
